title: Mall Evacuation
content: Scary dream last night. I’m in a mall with my oldest son (20) and we’re looking at clothes that are too small for me (not sure the significance of THAT!) when this random, creepy hovering robot came over to tell us that the mall was being evacuated because they had terminated an employee and he had set a bomb in the mall somewhere. My immediate panic was that my youngest son (11) had gone to hang out with some friends elsewhere in this mall. I started to run at top speed and asked a security guard to help me find him. My older son kept correcting me about what he was wearing. I remembered him wearing a red shirt and blue shorts.. my older son thought he was wearing yellow shorts. SO random! I found him pretty quickly - but he was only maybe 6 or 7 years old… not 11 like he is now. Not sure if we ever made it out of the mall!
